description: Release only evidenced capabilities with reproducible artifacts and a practical migration path. The first core/Python release must not wait for optional domains, language bindings, process models or Power Platform.
external_dependencies: edithatogo/repository-standards and existing portfolio CI/release practices: select applicable maintained controls rather than invent a new governance layer.
Domain package maintainers: migration, public API compatibility and archive/successor decisions remain repository-specific.
Package registries and source licensors: package identity/rights and any external release conditions must be verified at publication.
completion_evidence: A core/Python release can qualify after contracts, kernel and the two consumers; optional integration tracks remain independently planned or experimental.
Advertised capabilities match exact source, artifact, platform, method and data versions actually checked.
Dependency licences/advisories, permissions, provenance and source-data redistribution constraints have recorded outcomes.
Installed artifacts exercise native functionality and reference cases; passing source-tree tests alone is insufficient.
Existing consumer APIs have a documented migration and recovery path before shared machinery is removed.
No archive is executed from a recommendation alone; unique history/research, rights, successor behaviour and any required authorization are retained.
